name: JW Marriott Hotel Hanoi
positioning: Lakeside hotel in western Hanoi beside the Vietnam National Convention Center, in a cantilevered building by architect Carlos Zapata, with gardens and an eighth-floor wellness floor
best_for: Travelers who want space and calm with gardens and a large indoor pool
Families who enjoy garden activities and a kids' cafe

facts.text: The hotel has a peaceful lakeside setting in Tu Liem Ward, Hanoi.
The hotel sits beside the Vietnam National Convention Center in western Hanoi.
The hotel was designed by architect Carlos Zapata.
The hotel's designs tell the legend of the Dragon (Lac Long Quan) and the Fairy (Au Co).
JW Lakeside Gardens is a spacious lakeside garden where guests may encounter birds and small animals.
Wellbeing on 8 combines Spa L'Occitane en Provence, a fitness center and a suspended pool.
Spa L'Occitane en Provence offers treatments including couples massages, facials and body wraps.
Every room features air purifiers, humidity control systems, automatic bidets and smart TVs with Netflix and YouTube streaming.
Suite guests enjoy Executive Lounge access and in-suite check-in.
A coffee making class teaches guests to brew Vietnamese coffee with a phin filter.
French Grill serves modern French cuisine prepared in an open kitchen.
The hotel holds Green Globe Certification.

highlights.text: The indoor lap pool is suspended on the eighth floor beneath floor-to-ceiling windows.
The cantilevered building takes inspiration from Vietnam's coastline and the image of a dragon rising beside the water.
A horticulturist leads guests through the JW Greenhouse, JW Herb Garden and JW Animal Farm.
Balcony Rooms have a private balcony with views of the lake and the city skyline.
Guests can take a cooking class at JW Lakeside Gardens using herbs grown in the hotel's gardens.

considerations.text: The historic center is roughly a 30- to 40-minute drive from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
